pairs.target: dìèrtiān wǔhòu , tǎ wéi dào dōng wū shí ,
pairs.english: When Tavi reached the east room the following afternoon,
pairs.hanzi: 第二天午后，塔维到东屋时，

pairs.target: lièkāi de mù jiǎo yǐjīng yā zài liǎngkuài hòubǎn zhījiān .
pairs.english: the split wooden corner was already pressed between two thick boards.
pairs.hanzi: 裂开的木角已经压在两块厚板之间。

pairs.target: mǐlā zài shàngmiàn gē le yìzhī zhuāng suì tiě de hézi ,
pairs.english: Mira had set a box of scrap iron on top,
pairs.hanzi: 米拉在上面搁了一只装碎铁的盒子，

pairs.target: hégài méi hé , jǐméi duǎn dīng lù zài wàitou .
pairs.english: leaving the lid open and several short nails exposed.
pairs.hanzi: 盒盖没合，几枚短钉露在外头。

pairs.target: tā bǎ dàilái de jiāo guàn fàngzài zhuōbiān , méiyǒu pèng nà kuàibǎn .
pairs.english: He put the pot of glue he had brought beside the table without touching the board.
pairs.hanzi: 他把带来的胶罐放在桌边，没有碰那块板。

pairs.target: " zuótiān zěnme liè de ? "
pairs.english: “How did it split yesterday?”
pairs.hanzi: “昨天怎么裂的？”

pairs.target: " zhuǎnguò péng mén de shíhòu kē le . " yīwén shuō .
pairs.english: “It hit the doorway as we turned through the shed door,” Iven said.
pairs.hanzi: “转过棚门的时候磕了。”伊文说。

pairs.target: tā zhèng yòng dāoxiāo yìgēn móxíng lǐ de lángān , mùxiè luò mǎn qiánjīn ,
pairs.english: He was whittling a railing for the model with a knife, shavings covering the front of his clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 他正用刀削一根模型里的栏杆，木屑落满前襟，

pairs.target: " wǒ táigāo le yìtóu , lìngyìtóu méi gēnshàng .
pairs.english: “I raised one end and the other didn't follow.
pairs.hanzi: “我抬高了一头，另一头没跟上。

pairs.target: búshì hěn zhòng , jiùshì tài kuān , liǎnggè rén kànbújiàn bǐcǐ de jiǎo . "
pairs.english: It wasn't very heavy, just too wide; the two of us couldn't see each other's feet.”
pairs.hanzi: 不是很重，就是太宽，两个人看不见彼此的脚。”

pairs.target: mǐlā yòu bǔ le yíjù : " hòulái xiàyǔ , wǒmen pà mùliào shòucháo , méi děngdào biérén .
pairs.english: Mira added, “Then it rained, and we were afraid the timber would get damp, so we didn't wait for anyone else.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉又补了一句：“后来下雨，我们怕木料受潮，没等到别人。

pairs.target: nǐ lái yǐqián gāng tíng . "
pairs.english: It had only just stopped before you came.”
pairs.hanzi: 你来以前刚停。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuórì lián yǔ yě méi liúyì .
pairs.english: Tavi hadn't even noticed the rain yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维昨日连雨也没留意。

pairs.target: ménfáng de lángyán hěn shēn , tā jìde zhǐ jiǎo bèi fēngchuī qǐlái ,
pairs.english: The gatehouse eaves were deep; he remembered the wind lifting the corner of the paper,
pairs.hanzi: 门房的廊檐很深，他记得纸角被风吹起来，

pairs.target: què bú jìde dìmiàn shénme shíhòu shī guò .
pairs.english: but he could not remember when the ground had got wet.
pairs.hanzi: 却不记得地面什么时候湿过。

pairs.target: " shì wǒ dāying le yòu méi lái . " tā shuō ,
pairs.english: “I promised and then didn't come,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “是我答应了又没来。”他说，

pairs.target: " zhōngxiǎng de shíhòu , wǒ qíshí xiǎng qǐlái le . "
pairs.english: “Actually, when the bell rang, I did remember.”
pairs.hanzi: “钟响的时候，我其实想起来了。”

pairs.target: yīwén shǒulǐ de dāo tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: The knife in Iven's hand paused.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文手里的刀停了一下。

pairs.target: mǐlā wàng zhe tā , liǎnshàng nà diǎn děng zhe tīng jiěshì de shénqíng fǎnér dàn xiàqù .
pairs.english: Mira looked at him; that faint look of waiting for an explanation actually faded from her face.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉望着他，脸上那点等着听解释的神情反而淡下去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xìn ná chūlái , fàngzài méiyǒu mùxiè de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi took out the letter and laid it where there were no shavings.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把信拿出来，放在没有木屑的地方。

pairs.target: " zhège dìfāng , kěnéng gēn zhǎodào wǒ de nàliàngchē yǒuguān .
pairs.english: “This place might be connected to the wagon they found me in.
pairs.hanzi: “这个地方，可能跟找到我的那辆车有关。

pairs.target: yě kěnéng yìdiǎn guānxì dōu méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Or it might have nothing to do with it.
pairs.hanzi: 也可能一点关系都没有。

pairs.target: wǒ zhīdào gāi xiān guòlái , huòzhě tuō gèrén shuō yìshēng .
pairs.english: I knew I ought to come here first or get someone to pass on a message.
pairs.hanzi: 我知道该先过来，或者托个人说一声。

pairs.target: wǒ jiùshì …… zuò zhe méi dòng . "
pairs.english: I just... sat there.”
pairs.hanzi: 我就是……坐着没动。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán biàn búzài zhǎo biéde huà .
pairs.english: Once he had said it, he stopped searching for anything else to say.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完便不再找别的话。

pairs.target: wūwài yǒurén tuōdòng chángdèng , cìěr de yìshēng guòqù , wūlǐ xiǎnde gèng jìng .
pairs.english: Someone dragged a bench outside; after the piercing sound passed, the room seemed quieter.
pairs.hanzi: 屋外有人拖动长凳，刺耳的一声过去，屋里显得更静。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu lìkè ná xìn .
pairs.english: Mira didn't take the letter at once.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有立刻拿信。

pairs.target: tā nǐng le nǐng jiāo guàn de gàizi , wèn shìbushì yǐjīng tiáo hǎo de . tǎ wéi shuō hái méiyǒu .
pairs.english: She twisted the lid of the glue pot and asked whether it was already mixed. Tavi said it wasn't yet.
pairs.hanzi: 她拧了拧胶罐的盖子，问是不是已经调好的。塔维说还没有。

pairs.target: " nà xiān bié kāi . zhè guàn liú zhe , jiù de gòuyòng . "
pairs.english: “Then don't open it yet. Keep this pot; the old one is enough.”
pairs.hanzi: “那先别开。这罐留着，旧的够用。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěn píngcháng , tǎ wéi xiōngkǒu nà kǒuqì què sōng le yìdiǎn ,
pairs.english: She said it quite ordinarily, but the breath caught in Tavi's chest loosened a little,
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很平常，塔维胸口那口气却松了一点，

pairs.target: yòu bùgǎn sōng dé tài duō .
pairs.english: though he didn't dare let it loosen too much.
pairs.hanzi: 又不敢松得太多。

pairs.target: yīwén cā gānjìng shǒu , xiān wèn néng bunéng kàn ,
pairs.english: Iven wiped his hands clean and first asked if he could read it;
pairs.hanzi: 伊文擦干净手，先问能不能看，

pairs.target: děng tǎ wéi diǎntóu , cái bǎ xìn lājìn . mǐlā yě zhàn guòlái .
pairs.english: only after Tavi nodded did he draw the letter closer. Mira came over too.
pairs.hanzi: 等塔维点头，才把信拉近。米拉也站过来。

pairs.target: tāmen kàn huòdān de shíhòu méiyǒu shuōhuà .
pairs.english: They said nothing while reading the manifest.
pairs.hanzi: 他们看货单的时候没有说话。

pairs.target: fān dào jiù péng de tú , yīwén de zhǐjiān tíng zài cháng wūhòu de jǐngbiān .
pairs.english: When they turned to the old yard plan, Iven's fingertip stopped by the well behind the long building.
pairs.hanzi: 翻到旧棚的图，伊文的指尖停在长屋后的井边。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiǎng qù zhèlǐ ? "
pairs.english: “You want to go here?”
pairs.hanzi: “你想去这里？”

pairs.target: " zuótiān xiǎng . jīntiān yě xiǎng . "
pairs.english: “Yesterday I did. Today too.”
pairs.hanzi: “昨天想。今天也想。”

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ tú zhuǎn le bànquān . " zhè huà de shì cóngqián . "
pairs.english: Mira turned the plan halfway around. “This shows how it used to be.”
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把图转了半圈。“这画的是从前。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . " tǎ wéi dá dé tài kuài , zìjǐ yě tīng chūlái le .
pairs.english: “I know.” Tavi answered too quickly and heard it himself.
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。”塔维答得太快，自己也听出来了。

pairs.target: tā shēnshǒu fúzhù zhǐbiān , guò le yíhuìer cái shuō ,
pairs.english: He reached out to steady the edge of the paper and only after a while said,
pairs.hanzi: 他伸手扶住纸边，过了一会儿才说，

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào de shì , hǎoxiàng zǒng bǐ wǒ xiǎng zuò de shì shǎo . "
pairs.english: “What I know always seems to be less than what I want to do.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道的事，好像总比我想做的事少。”

pairs.target: yīwén méi xiào .
pairs.english: Iven didn't laugh.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没笑。

pairs.target: tā yǐqián zài fùqīn de fánglǐ jiàn guò huò lù cè ,
pairs.english: He had seen freight-route registers in his father's room before,
pairs.hanzi: 他以前在父亲的房里见过货路册，

pairs.target: zhīdào yǒuxiē dìmíng guò le shuǐkǒu biàn huàn yìzhǒng xiěfǎ ,
pairs.english: and knew some place names were written differently beyond a river junction.
pairs.hanzi: 知道有些地名过了水口便换一种写法，

pairs.target: dāying zhōumò péi tǎ wéi zhǎo lù tīng xiànzài de fāngwèi .
pairs.english: He promised to help Tavi find Reed Reach's present location at the weekend.
pairs.hanzi: 答应周末陪塔维找鹭汀现在的方位。

pairs.target: tā shuō dào " zhōumò ", tèyì kàn le yìyǎn mǐlā .
pairs.english: As he said “the weekend,” he gave Mira a deliberate glance.
pairs.hanzi: 他说到“周末”，特意看了一眼米拉。

pairs.target: mǐlā yòng zhǐjiǎ guāqù zhuōshàng de yìdiǎn gānjiāo .
pairs.english: Mira scraped a little dried glue off the table with a fingernail.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉用指甲刮去桌上的一点干胶。

pairs.target: " jīntiān nǐmen háiyào huà nányuàn de zhuǎnjiǎo . " tā shuō ,
pairs.english: “Today you still need to draw the south yard's corners,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “今天你们还要画南院的转角。”她说，

pairs.target: " wǒ bùxiǎng líndào yǎnliàn , zhī shèng wǒ yígè rén zhīdào zhège móxíng zěnme zǒu . "
pairs.english: “I don't want to reach the exercise with only me knowing how to navigate this model.”
pairs.hanzi: “我不想临到演练，只剩我一个人知道这个模型怎么走。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuówǎn yǐ bǎ jièshūchù de kāifàng shíchén xiě zài zhǐbèi .
pairs.english: Last night Tavi had already written the library's opening hours on the back of a sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维昨晚已把借书处的开放时辰写在纸背。

pairs.target: jīntiān néng jiè jiùdì míngcè , xià yícì yào děng liǎngtiān .
pairs.english: Today he could borrow the old place-name register; the next chance was in two days.
pairs.hanzi: 今天能借旧地名册，下一次要等两天。

pairs.target: tā mō dào nà zhāng zhǐ , méi ná chūlái .
pairs.english: He felt the sheet but didn't take it out.
pairs.hanzi: 他摸到那张纸，没拿出来。

pairs.target: " jīntiān huà wán . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “We'll finish today,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “今天画完。”他说。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ chǐ dìgěi tā , zìjǐ nuókāi tiěhé jiǎnchá lièkǒu .
pairs.english: Mira passed him the ruler, then moved the iron box to inspect the split herself.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把尺递给他，自己挪开铁盒检查裂口。

pairs.target: mùtou yǐjīng tiēhé , báo biān què quē le mǔzhǐ dà de yíkuài ,
pairs.english: The wood had joined, but a thumb-sized piece was missing from the thin edge;
pairs.hanzi: 木头已经贴合，薄边却缺了拇指大的一块，

pairs.target: jiāo bǔ bù chū diūdiào de bùfen .
pairs.english: glue couldn't replace the lost piece.
pairs.hanzi: 胶补不出丢掉的部分。

pairs.target: tā yòng tàn zài nà yìjiǎo huà le gè xiǎo fāngkuàng , dǎsuàn ān yíduàn kě chāi de wéilán ,
pairs.english: She drew a small square in that corner with charcoal, planning a removable section of fence,
pairs.hanzi: 她用炭在那一角画了个小方框，打算安一段可拆的围栏，

pairs.target: zhènghǎo ràng ná móxíng de rén kànqīng nǎ yìbiān shì rùkǒu .
pairs.english: which would let anyone holding the model see exactly which side the entrance was on.
pairs.hanzi: 正好让拿模型的人看清哪一边是入口。

pairs.target: " zhèyàng gǎi , shìyīnwèi huài le cái gǎi de ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Are you changing it this way because it broke?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “这样改，是因为坏了才改的？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " shì . yuánlái nàyàng hǎokàn xiē . " mǐlā bǎ chǐ náhuíqù liáng le yícì ,
pairs.english: “Yes. It looked nicer before.” Mira took back the ruler and measured again.
pairs.hanzi: “是。原来那样好看些。”米拉把尺拿回去量了一次，

pairs.target: " xiànzài zhèyàng yě yǒuyòng . liǎnghuíshì . "
pairs.english: “This way is useful too. That's a separate thing.”
pairs.hanzi: “现在这样也有用。两回事。”

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ zìjǐ xiāo hǎo de lángān dìguòqù .
pairs.english: Iven handed over the railing he had whittled.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把自己削好的栏杆递过去。

pairs.target: tàicū , chā bú jìn kǒng .
pairs.english: Too thick: it wouldn't fit in the hole.
pairs.hanzi: 太粗，插不进孔。

pairs.target: tā shìtú jiěshì zhè shì wèile jiēshi ,
pairs.english: He tried to explain that this was for strength,
pairs.hanzi: 他试图解释这是为了结实，

pairs.target: mǐlā jiào tā ná yígè móxíng xiǎorén lái , kàn zhègēn lángān shìbushì bǐ rén de yāo hái cū .
pairs.english: but Mira told him to fetch a model person and see whether the railing was thicker than its waist.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉叫他拿一个模型小人来，看这根栏杆是不是比人的腰还粗。

pairs.target: sāngè rén dōu dītóu kàn nà jié mùgùn .
pairs.english: All three bent their heads to look at the stick.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人都低头看那截木棍。

pairs.target: yīwén zhōngyú bǎ tā náhuíqù , xiāo dìèrbiàn .
pairs.english: Iven finally took it back to whittle it a second time.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文终于把它拿回去，削第二遍。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài lìng yíkuài báobǎn shàng miáo lóutī .
pairs.english: Tavi traced the stairs on another thin board.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在另一块薄板上描楼梯。

pairs.target: tā yuánxiān zhī jì le jíshù , zhèhuí zhàozhe tú bǎ píngtái yě huà chūlái ,
pairs.english: Originally he had noted only the number of steps; this time he drew the landing too, following the plan,
pairs.hanzi: 他原先只记了级数，这回照着图把平台也画出来，

pairs.target: zài yòng shǒuzhǐ yánlù zǒu dào guǎijiǎo .
pairs.english: then followed the route to the corner with his finger.
pairs.hanzi: 再用手指沿路走到拐角。

pairs.target: ruò cóng zuǒbiān lái , qiáng hòu de mén biàn kànbújiàn .
pairs.english: Coming from the left, you wouldn't see the door behind the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 若从左边来，墙后的门便看不见。

pairs.target: tā ná qǐ tàn xiǎng tiān yídào jiàntóu , tíngzhù ,
pairs.english: He picked up the charcoal to add an arrow, then paused,
pairs.hanzi: 他拿起炭想添一道箭头，停住，

pairs.target: xiān wèn mǐlā zhè shì gěi rén zhǎo lù de tú , háishì gěi rén kàn jiégòu de .
pairs.english: first asking Mira whether this was a navigation plan or a view of the structure.
pairs.hanzi: 先问米拉这是给人找路的图，还是给人看结构的。

pairs.target: " zhè zhāng gěi rén zhǎo lù . " tā shuō ,
pairs.english: “This one's for navigation,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “这张给人找路。”她说，

pairs.target: " jiàntóu bié huà zài lóutī shàng , huì xiàng duō yìgēn lángān . "
pairs.english: “Don't draw the arrow on the stairs; it'll look like another railing.”
pairs.hanzi: “箭头别画在楼梯上，会像多一根栏杆。”

pairs.target: chuāngwài de liàng chù mànmàn biànzhǎi .
pairs.english: The light outside the window slowly narrowed.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外的亮处慢慢变窄。

pairs.target: jièshūchù guānmén de zhōngxiǎng shí , tǎ wéi zhèng bǎ zuìhòu yídào húxiàn cādiào zhònghuà .
pairs.english: When the library's closing bell rang, Tavi was erasing and redrawing the last curve.
pairs.hanzi: 借书处关门的钟响时，塔维正把最后一道弧线擦掉重画。

pairs.target: yīwén tīngjiàn zhōng , táiqǐ tóu ; tǎ wéi yáo le yáotóu , jiào tā bǎ bǎn zài zhuǎnguò lái yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Iven heard the bell and looked up; Tavi shook his head and asked him to turn the board a little farther.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文听见钟，抬起头；塔维摇了摇头，叫他把板再转过来一点。

pairs.target: tāmen méiyǒu bǎ zuótiān de shì shuō chéng yǐjīng guòqù .
pairs.english: They didn't declare yesterday's affair settled.
pairs.hanzi: 他们没有把昨天的事说成已经过去。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn qián mǐlā shōushí hǎo dōngxī , réng zìjǐ ná zhe móxíng , jiào tǎ wéi dài kōnghézi .
pairs.english: Before supper Mira packed up, still carrying the model herself, and told Tavi to take the empty box.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭前米拉收拾好东西，仍自己拿着模型，叫塔维带空盒子。

pairs.target: zǒu dào ménbiān , tā què tíngxià , bǎ dǐbǎn de yìduān dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: But at the door she stopped and handed him one end of the baseboard.
pairs.hanzi: 走到门边，她却停下，把底板的一端递给他。

pairs.target: " píng zhe ná . biétì wǒ juédìng nǎ yìtóu néng qiàoqǐlái . "
pairs.english: “Keep it level. Don't decide for me which end can tip up.”
pairs.hanzi: “平着拿。别替我决定哪一头能翘起来。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiē wěn le .
pairs.english: Tavi took a steady hold.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接稳了。

pairs.target: yīwén zǒu zài qiánmiàn kāimén , xiāo huài de dìyīgēn lángān jiá zài ěr hòu , xiàng yì jié hěn bùtǐmiàn de yǔmáo .
pairs.english: Iven went ahead to open the door, the first botched railing tucked behind his ear like a very undignified feather.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文走在前面开门，削坏的第一根栏杆夹在耳后，像一截很不体面的羽毛。

pairs.target: mǐlā kànjiàn le , xiǎng rěn , méi rěnzhù xiào chū le shēng .
pairs.english: Mira saw it, tried to hold back, and couldn't help laughing aloud.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看见了，想忍，没忍住笑出了声。
